scope: Namespace, direct page loc and extension separation only. No full sitemap validator, engine equivalence or human review claim.

rules: Exact expanded namespaces, only direct base loc is page/index URL; XML whitespace trimming only, literal decoded URL comparison.
Known base optional fields and schemaLocation retained without semantic validation or network.
XHTML alternate rel/hreflang/href exact nonblank attributes only; image block exactly one image loc, optional caption/geo_location/title/license at most once; values not semantically assessed.
Unknown names/namespaces/attributes, ambiguous structures, DTD/entities, malformed XML or bounds are inconclusive.
Complete parse before any result; old profile behavior unchanged; full traversal before omission; known competitor survives another missing branch.
